postData.contentHtml:
In a testament to the accelerating integration of artificial intelligence within the financial sector, Allooloo Technologies Corp. has announced an extraordinary benchmark: over 100 million AI agent interactions per month in capital markets. This impressive figure translates to approximately 39 calls per second, or a staggering 3.4 billion calls monthly, across its flagship platforms getissuer.ai and Issuerwire.ai.

Allooloo is directly addressing a critical industry challenge known as the 'data readiness gap.' While investment banks are flush with AI models, a significant hurdle remains in providing AI agents with readily usable data. A 2026 Teradata study highlighted that a mere 20% or less of enterprise data is prepared for AI agents. Allooloo bridges this gap by supplying the crucial external data an AI agent needs, offering agent-ready information on 41.9 thousand listed companies across 34 countries.

At the core of Allooloo's offering are its specialized 'zones of record' – gated, specialist datasets that financial AI agents consult before executing trades, making recommendations, or securing approvals. These datasets are meticulously sourced, dated, and signed, ensuring high integrity and traceability.

Two pivotal products underpin Allooloo's success:

  • Know Your Product (KYP) via getissuer.ai: This platform helps AI agents fulfill the duty to understand a security before it's recommended or sold. It provides comprehensive details on the issuer, its tradability, and target audience, covering 41.9K listed companies on 79 exchanges in 34 countries.
  • Issuerwire.ai: A dated disclosure wire, offering 3.1 million dated disclosures across 34 countries, each accompanied by its source.

Transparency and compliance are paramount. Every cleared read on Allooloo's platforms generates a 'Record of Cleared Orders (RCO),' a signed receipt documenting what was read, when, and under which market's rules. This feature provides an auditable trail, crucial for financial regulations.

Allooloo's robust infrastructure supports this high-volume operation, deploying across 24 Microsoft Azure hyperscale locations globally, complemented by always-on Amazon Web Services (AWS) redundancy. Each market's data is maintained within its respective country or region, ensuring data sovereignty and efficient access. As a Microsoft AI Cloud Partner, Allooloo leverages cutting-edge cloud technology to deliver its services.

The company's products are generated around the clock by a combination of Allooloo's dedicated team and its own AI agents, operating on the Allooloo Algo. Financial AI agents access these services on a pay-per-call basis (PayGo) using x402, an open payment standard for AI agents, or firms can license datasets for comprehensive enterprise-grade solutions.

Matthew Keddy, CEO of Allooloo Technologies Corp., emphasized the demand from capital markets participants for 'crisp data, five years deep, on 41.9K listed companies across 79 exchanges: sourced, dated and signed.' This achievement signals a new era where AI agents are empowered with verified, actionable data.

While social media sentiment around Allooloo's advancements in capital markets AI agent traffic is generally positive, some discussions and debates continue, reflecting the dynamic nature of AI adoption in highly regulated industries. This milestone solidifies Allooloo's position at the forefront of AI-driven financial intelligence, offering a blueprint for enhancing compliance, efficiency, and insight for banks, dealers, and issuers worldwide.
postData.title: Allooloo Surges Past 100 Million Monthly AI Agent Traffic, Revolutionizing Capital Markets
postData.summary: Allooloo Technologies Corp. announces a monumental achievement, exceeding 100 million monthly AI agent interactions in capital markets. This milestone, driven by its specialized 'zones of record' and innovative data readiness solutions, underscores a significant leap forward for AI in finance, offering unparalleled precision and compliance for critical financial decisions.
